_about: Prize money per race, entered by hand from organisers and press because World Athletics does not publish it. 'places' are open-division place prizes, the same for women and men unless given as {"W": [...], "M": [...]}. 'awarded_bonuses' are bonuses reported as actually paid. Appearance fees, sponsor bonuses and national-division prizes are never included. 'confidence': high = organiser or several agreeing sources; medium = one source; low = partial or conflicting.
usd_rates_note: Approximate fixed rates, used only to add up season totals in US dollars.
